description: Applying machine learning to fundamental scientific disciplines, planetary systems, and global health challenges to deliver measurable real-world impact.

areas.title: Earth AI
areas.summary: Building AI-powered planetary observation systems that monitor forest carbon, map surface water changes, and provide high-resolution geospatial intelligence.

areas.title: Health AI
areas.summary: Developing multimodal medical AI foundation models, automated screening for diabetic retinopathy, dermatology classification, and genomic variant calling.

areas.title: Science AI
areas.summary: Transforming molecular chemistry, protein structure prediction, materials discovery, and particle physics through neural simulation and physical inductive biases.

areas.title: Sustainability & Crisis Resilience
areas.summary: Operational flood forecasting covering over 460 million people globally, real-time wildfire boundary mapping via satellite imagery, and electrical grid optimization.

description: Inventing core machine learning algorithms, architectures, and theoretical foundations that power modern artificial intelligence.

areas.title: Algorithms & Theory
areas.summary: Designing scalable algorithms for sublinear graph streaming, continuous optimization, differential privacy bounds, and combinatorial algorithm design.

areas.title: Machine Intelligence
areas.summary: Frontier multimodal reasoning models, test-time compute scaling, tree-search trajectory verification, and autonomous agent systems.

areas.title: Machine Perception
areas.summary: Audio, visual, and multimodal understanding, 3D neural scene reconstruction (NeRF/Gaussian Splatting), and real-time sensory perception for robotics.

areas.title: Natural Language Processing
areas.summary: Inventing the Transformer architecture, advancing multilingual machine translation across 1,000 languages, and scaling context windows to millions of tokens.

areas.title: Information Retrieval
areas.summary: Dense vector retrieval, semantic ranking, neural re-ranking, and next-generation search engine architecture for world knowledge access.

description: Constructing the physical and algorithmic substrates of computation and ensuring AI is developed responsibly and equitably for humanity.

areas.title: Quantum AI
areas.summary: Developing superconducting transmon quantum processors, demonstrating quantum error correction below surface code thresholds with Willow.

areas.title: Responsible AI
areas.summary: Pioneering algorithmic fairness, red-teaming, mechanistic interpretability, watermarking for synthetic media (SynthID), and ethical AI principles.

areas.title: Human-Computer Interaction & Visualization
areas.summary: Designing collaborative human-AI interactions, generative user interfaces, accessible assistive technologies, and high-dimensional data visualization.

areas.title: Software & Hardware Systems
areas.summary: Architecting Google Tensor Processing Units (TPU v5p/Trillium), JAX compiler optimization, Borg distributed scheduling, and high-performance datacenter networks.
